lines.text: WE GOT JACK BACK!
Well the frog had a hat and the hat was tall,
He rained down froggies on us all,
The Queen was sweet but her heart was sour,
She banned our plays every single hour,
But we flipped that play and we ran it back,
'Cause nothing's can stop us gettin' Jack Back!
Hey ghosts! (WOOO!)
Hey golems! (UGH!)
Hey werewolves! (AWOOOO!)
Everybody... get... LOUD!
We got Jack back! (He's back! He's back!)
Pumpkin on the patch, now he's glowin' like that!
We got Jack back! (Say what? Say what?)
Carried him home in a big ol' sack!
Throw your claws up high, wave 'em side to side,
Shake your bones 'til the sun comes up outside,
We got Jack back! (Oh yeah!)
We got Jack... BACK!
Alright everybody, it's time to do... the Pumpkin Roll!
Step to the left! (Step!)
Step to the right! (Step!)
Rattle your bones! (Rattle rattle!)
Now ROLL like a gourd! (Rooooll!)
Zombies, you can just shuffle, that's fine.
He was lost... (lost!)
Now he's found... (found!)
Glowin' bright on the pumpkin ground...
Light him up! (Light him up!)
Light him up! (Light him up!)
LIGHT... HIM... UP!
We got Jack back! (He's back! He's back!)
Pumpkin on the patch, now he's glowin' like that!
We got Jack back! (Say what? Say what?)
Carried him home in a big ol' sack!
Throw your claws up high, wave 'em side to side,
Shake your bones 'til the sun comes up outside,
We got Jack back! (Oh yeah!)
We got Jack... BACK!
...wait, where's the frog?
